Elon  Musk  owns  20%  of  Tesla.  Jeff  Bezos 
 owns  9%  of  Amazon.  Jensen  Huang  owns  4% 
 of  Nvidia.  All  of  these 
 centibillionaires  understand  one  thing. 
 The  more  money  you  make  other  people, 
 the  more  money  you  make  for  yourself, 
 even  if  the  pie  is  not  100%  yours.  Any 
 big  goal  is  something  that's  far  away. 
 And  the  African  proverb  is,  if  you  want 
 to  go  fast,  go  alone.  If  you  want  to  go 
 far,  go  together.  Because  no  one  person 
 can  know  everything  that's  required  to 
 build  a  trillion-dollar  company.
